purpose: CheckLink canonical search-result URLs: keep only parameters that change what results are shown; remove everything else by default.
method: Verifier pass over ddg-brave-startpage-mojeek.json. Re-read the primary sources (DDG help pages and content-hashed front-end bundles, Brave Search API doc and Brave clean-URL list, Startpage help centre via its JSON API, Mojeek preferences/advanced/vertical forms and API doc, SearXNG engine modules at f4822b3fc467, 4get scrapers, degoog, DandelionSprout and AdGuard lists) and ran read-only live comparisons of result lists on DuckDuckGo (JS page d.js call and html.duckduckgo.com) and Brave Search on 2026-10-10. Startpage and Mojeek SERPs were blocked by captcha from this network, so their verdicts rest on sources. Tests preserve the original order of kept parameters.

paths: / (result page only when q is present, or when iaxm is present for maps; without them it is the homepage). Applies to duckduckgo.com, www, noai, safe, start, yesai and the onion host
/lite and /lite/ (non-JS lite results; duckduckgo.com/lite and lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/)
NOT result pages: /l/ (redirector, unwrap uddg), /y.js (ad click), /d.js /i.js /v.js /news.js /local.js (JSON APIs), /settings, /params, /bang, /ac/, /extension-success, /atb.js

functional.name: q
functional.meaning: Search query (operators such as site:, filetype: and !bangs are allowed). Verified.

functional.name: kl
functional.meaning: Region for results: xa-ar ... vn-vi, wt-wt = no region. Verified live 2026-10-10: html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q=bag&kl=de-de returned German results (bag.admin.ch, bundesarbeitsgericht.de) instead of the US set, and on the JS page kl=de-de became bing_market=de-DE in the d.js call.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/settings/params/ (kl Region, full value list); https://github.com/searxng/searxng/blob/f4822b3fc46726bb259d14c6332b702c76b98f82/searx/engines/duckduckgo.py (form field kl); live probe 2026-10-10

functional.name: kp
functional.meaning: Safe search: 1 strict, -1 moderate, -2 off. Verified: DDG help says to append &kp=1, &kp=-1 or &kp=-2 to force safe search; live 2026-10-10 kp=-2 became ex=-2 in d.js.

functional.name: kad
functional.meaning: Display language (en_GB, nb_NO; default wt_WT). It is not only cosmetic: verified live 2026-10-10 that kad=de_DE alone changed the d.js call to l=de-de and bing_market=de-DE and returned German results on html.duckduckgo.com, and kad=nb_NO switched l to wt-wt with a Norwegian Wikipedia hint (wpl=nb).
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/dist/util/u.9a6f65eb56a1d2e8cbab.js (kad Display Language); https://duckduckgo.com/dist/d.bf060419ed940a233888.js (LANGUAGE_KEY kad); https://duckduckgo.com/bang.js (duckgoes: kad=es_ES); live probe 2026-10-10
functional.condition: keep; changes the result market when kl is absent

functional.name: df
functional.meaning: Date filter: d, w, m, y, or a custom range YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD. Verified: declared as DDG.Data.HiddenFields DATE_FILTER:"df" in the front end; live 2026-10-10 html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q=bag&df=2026-01-01..2026-03-31 returned a different, dated result set; d.js receives df unchanged.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/features/dates/ (UI only, no parameter named); https://duckduckgo.com/dist/d.bf060419ed940a233888.js (HiddenFields DATE_FILTER); https://github.com/searxng/searxng/blob/f4822b3fc46726bb259d14c6332b702c76b98f82/searx/engines/duckduckgo.py (form field df); live probe 2026-10-10

functional.name: ia
functional.meaning: Vertical or instant-answer id. DDG's own resolver (module 17938 in the wpm bundle, read verbatim): ia=chat gives chat; else any iaxm gives maps; else ia=images&iax=images, or iar=images with no ia and no iax, gives images; the same pattern for videos and shopping; ia=recipes&iax=recipes gives recipes; ia=news&iar=news, or iar=news with no ia and no iax, gives news; anything else is web. ia=web and instant-answer ids (about, answer, definition, calculator, soundcloud, ...) therefore never change the vertical.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/dist/wpm.main.6ef5bbf2bfce334a5036.js (function r({iax,iar,iaxm,ia}) exported as getValidVerticalId); https://duckduckgo.com/bang.js (ddgi, dim, ddgv, ddgn, news, chat, ai)
functional.condition: keep only when the resolved vertical is not web, and only if ia participates in that resolution; drop ia=web and IA ids (owner's test)

functional.name: iax
functional.meaning: Expanded vertical paired with ia: images, videos, shopping, recipes. Verified by the resolver: it only counts when equal to ia.
functional.condition: keep with ia when ia and iax are equal and select images, videos, shopping or recipes; drop otherwise

functional.name: iar
functional.meaning: IA requery (DDG.Data.HiddenFields IA_REQUERY). Selects images, videos, shopping or news on its own only when ia and iax are both absent; required together with ia=news. Verified: resolver code; live 2026-10-10 ?q=bag&iar=images forwarded iar=images to d.js.
functional.condition: keep when it is the deciding signal (no ia and no iax) or with ia=news; drop when ia+iax already decide

functional.name: iaxm
functional.meaning: Maps vertical: maps, directions (start is the empty maps start page). Any non-empty value resolves to maps. Verified in the resolver and the maps URL builder.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/dist/wpm.main.6ef5bbf2bfce334a5036.js (resolver; maps URL builder switch on iaxm maps/directions/start); https://duckduckgo.com/bang.js (ddgm: iaxm=maps)

functional.name: start
functional.meaning: Directions origin (serialised place). Verified in the maps URL builder, which writes start only when iaxm=directions.
functional.condition: only with iaxm=directions; elsewhere start=1 is the start.duckduckgo.com display mode and is non-functional

functional.name: end
functional.meaning: Directions destination (serialised place). Verified in the maps URL builder.

functional.name: transport
functional.meaning: Directions transport mode: automobile (default), walking, cycling. Verified in the maps code (allowed list and default).

functional.name: bbox
functional.meaning: Map viewport as west,north,east,south decimal degrees; bounds the local results. Verified: parsed by a regex of four comma-separated numbers and fed to the local search as the bounding box.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/dist/wpm.main.6ef5bbf2bfce334a5036.js (function N parses bbox; maps URL builder writes bbox)

functional.name: strict_bbox
functional.meaning: strict_bbox=1 restricts local results to the bbox. Verified in the maps URL builder (written only when iaxm=maps).

functional.name: iaf
functional.meaning: Image, video and shopping filter facets as key:value pairs, e.g. size:imagesize-large. Verified: bang il uses it, and the front end clears iaf whenever the user leaves the images, videos or shopping vertical. Token vocabulary beyond the documented example is inferred.
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/bang.js (il: iaf=size%3Aimagesize-large); https://duckduckgo.com/dist/g.edb8e6b509facf195f5c.js (clearReactParams clears iaf outside images/videos/shopping)
functional.condition: images, videos or shopping vertical only

functional.name: sites
functional.meaning: Restricts results to a domain; DDG rewrites it into a site: operator. Verified live 2026-10-10: ?q=bag&sites=wikipedia.org produced d.js?q=bag%20site%3Awikipedia.org. Ignored on html.duckduckgo.com (live: same results as without it).
functional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/bang.js (aamulehti, h2m, mjtsai use sites=); live probe 2026-10-10
functional.condition: JS result page; harmless on /html and /lite

functional.name: kbj
functional.meaning: Hide AI-generated images. Verified live 2026-10-10: kbj=1 added hide_ai_images=1 to the d.js call (noai.duckduckgo.com sends the same flag).

functional.name: ds
functional.meaning: Date sort hidden field (DDG.Data.HiddenFields DATE_SORT). Verified live 2026-10-10 that ds=1 is forwarded to the d.js backend call; accepted values not confirmed.

functional.name: prompt
functional.meaning: Duck.ai hand-off flag (prompt=1). The front end clears it whenever the vertical is not chat, so it only matters with ia=chat; inferred to make Duck.ai answer q straight away.

functional.name: s
functional.meaning: Result offset on the non-JS html/lite pages (page 2 = 10, then +15). Verified live 2026-10-10: DDG only paginates a GET when s comes with api=d.js, v, o, nextParams and a valid vqd; with s alone (or s with a missing or fake vqd) DDG serves page 1, and with api=d.js but no valid vqd it serves an error page. So a cleaned page-2 link opens page 1; s is kept because it is harmless and records the intended page.
functional.condition: only on /html and /lite; never keep api, v, o or nextParams without vqd

nonfunctional.name: t
nonfunctional.meaning: Partner/source code for ad revenue share and anonymous usage counts (h_, ffab, ffsb, brave, ddg_android, noai). Verified live 2026-10-10: html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q=bag&t=h_ returned the identical organic list to ?q=bag; on the JS page it is passed to d.js as a=, an attribution field.
nonfunctional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/privacy/t/ (developers add &t= to assign advertising revenue and collect anonymous aggregate usage information); https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/TrackParamFilter/sections/specific.txt (removeparam=t); live probe 2026-10-10

nonfunctional.name: origin
nonfunctional.meaning: Funnel attribution (funnel_home_website etc.). Live: organic set unchanged.

nonfunctional.name: atb
nonfunctional.meaning: Install cohort attribution; forwarded to d.js as atb. Live: organic set unchanged. AdGuard keeps its rule commented out only because in-browser stripping broke the DDG extension success page.

nonfunctional.name: set_atb
nonfunctional.meaning: Retention cohort.

nonfunctional.name: natb
nonfunctional.meaning: New-install ATB marker.

nonfunctional.name: cp
nonfunctional.meaning: Click-pixel state.

nonfunctional.name: va, exti
nonfunctional.meaning: Extension variant and install-state markers.

nonfunctional.name: from, vis, perf_id, parent_perf_id, experiment_*
nonfunctional.meaning: Telemetry and A/B markers.

nonfunctional.name: dc
nonfunctional.meaning: Display counter submitted with s on html/lite next-page forms. Moved from functional: verified live 2026-10-10 that html page 2 returns the same results with or without dc, and dc does nothing without vqd.

nonfunctional.name: ko
nonfunctional.meaning: Header display (apps send ko=-1). Live: organic set unchanged.

nonfunctional.name: k1
nonfunctional.meaning: Advertisements on/off; removes ads only, organic list unchanged (live 2026-10-10).

nonfunctional.name: kah
nonfunctional.meaning: Stores the previous region. Verified live 2026-10-10: kah=de-de had no effect on the d.js call, with or without kl.

nonfunctional.name: kbg
nonfunctional.meaning: Hide Duck.ai entry points.

nonfunctional.name: dindextoken
nonfunctional.meaning: Search token added by the iOS app.

nonfunctional.name: kz, kc, kav, kn, kf, kaf, kac, kd, kh, kg, k5
nonfunctional.meaning: Result display and privacy/behaviour preferences (Open Instant Answers, auto-load, new window, favicons, full URLs, auto-suggest, redirect, HTTPS, GET/POST, video playback). Live 2026-10-10: of these only kz reached d.js, and it controls whether instant answers open, not the result set.
nonfunctional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/settings/params/ (Result Settings and Privacy Settings tables); live probe 2026-10-10

nonfunctional.name: kj, kx, k7, k8, k9, kaa, kae, ks, kw, km, ka, ku, kt, kv, kaj
nonfunctional.meaning: Colours, theme, size, width, placement, fonts, underline, page numbers, units.

nonfunctional.name: kai, kbh, kbi, kbe, kbl, kbd, kbf, kk, kat, kar, kay, kbk, kak, kao, kaq
nonfunctional.meaning: Display and AI-feature preferences (Search Assist frequency, compact results, map rendering, homepage elements).

nonfunctional.name: iai
nonfunctional.meaning: Selected item in the detail pane (view state; in maps the selected place).

nonfunctional.name: source
nonfunctional.meaning: UI origin of a maps or directions view (maps, places, about, directions). Only used to borrow a bounding box from modules already loaded in the same page, so it has no effect on a fresh load.
nonfunctional.source: https://duckduckgo.com/dist/wpm.main.6ef5bbf2bfce334a5036.js (bbox fallback reads source=about|maps from the in-page snapshot)

nonfunctional.name: bang, assiston
nonfunctional.meaning: !bang origin marker (bang=true on Duck.ai bangs); force Search Assist answer (inferred).

nonfunctional.name: vqd
nonfunctional.meaning: Anti-bot validation digest generated from the query and the User-Agent; required for html/lite page 2+, but must not be kept: it is browser-specific and DDG treats replayed or mismatched values as bot traffic.
nonfunctional.source: https://github.com/searxng/searxng/blob/f4822b3fc46726bb259d14c6332b702c76b98f82/searx/engines/duckduckgo.py (vqd docstring); live probe 2026-10-10 (fake vqd gave an error page)

nonfunctional.name: b, nextParams, v, o, api
nonfunctional.meaning: html/lite form plumbing. Verified live 2026-10-10: b= has no effect; api=d.js (with v, o, nextParams) without a valid vqd yields DDG's error page, so these must be dropped together with vqd.

engines.notes: Verifier changes (2026-10-10): kad upgraded from interface-only to result-affecting (live); dc moved to non-functional (live: page 2 identical without it); added start, end, transport (directions), prompt (chat, inferred); bbox and strict_bbox upgraded from inferred to confirmed (maps URL builder); kbj and ds confirmed as forwarded to the backend; s kept with the finding that GET pagination needs a valid vqd, so cleaned page-2 links open page 1; added start.duckduckgo.com and yesai.duckduckgo.com (listed in DDG's own host list and serving results live). Vertical rule (DDG resolver, read verbatim): chat if ia=chat; maps if iaxm; images/videos/shopping if ia equals iax, or iar alone with no ia and no iax; recipes if ia=iax=recipes; news if ia=iar=news, or iar=news alone; else web. If web, drop ia, iax, iar, iaxm; otherwise keep only the parameters that took part. Hosts carry settings of their own: safe.duckduckgo.com forces strict safe search (live: p=1 in d.js) and noai.duckduckgo.com hides AI images (hide_ai_images=1, a=noai), so never rewrite the host. /l/?uddg= is a redirector to unwrap (ClearURLs redirection rule). /y.js ad links carry ad_provider, ad_domain, click_metadata, iurl, ad_type, vqd (AdGuard strips them). kl, kp, kad, df are also cookies, so rendering can still vary per viewer. Front-end bundle URLs are content-hashed (read 2026-10-10).

paths: /ask (Ask Brave AI answer page; q only)

functional.name: q
functional.meaning: Search query (operators and !bangs). Verified.

functional.name: offset
functional.meaning: Zero-based page index (offset=1 is page 2; SearXNG tested up to offset=8). Verified live 2026-10-10: /search?q=bag&offset=1 (with or without spellcheck=0) returned a different, page-2 result list; /videos?offset=1 also paginated.

functional.name: spellcheck
functional.meaning: spellcheck=0 disables automatic query correction; Brave's own pagination links add it. Verified live 2026-10-10: q=bagg+recieve was rewritten to "bagg receive" (altered) by default, while spellcheck=0 kept the original query and returned a different result list.

functional.name: tf
functional.meaning: Time filter: pd, pw, pm, py, at (any time, default) or a custom range YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD. Verified live 2026-10-10: tf=pw changed the result list on /search, /news and /videos.

functional.name: country
functional.meaning: Result country, two-letter lowercase code (all = no country). Verified live 2026-10-10: /search?q=bag&country=de returned German results (bundesarbeitsgericht.de, got-bag.com) instead of the US set; reflected in page state on /images too.

functional.name: search_lang
functional.meaning: Language of results (ISO 639-1). Read from the URL (live 2026-10-10: page state showed searchLang:"de"), but no visible change for q=bag or q=gift; kept because the API defines it as a content-language filter.
functional.source: https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/app/documentation/web-search/query (search_lang: filter results by content language); live probe 2026-10-10

functional.name: lang
functional.meaning: Interface language. Verified live 2026-10-10: lang=de switched the page to html lang="de-de" while the result list stayed identical.
functional.source: live probe 2026-10-10 (ui_lang and language are not honoured via URL)

functional.name: safesearch
functional.meaning: off, moderate (default), strict. Verified live 2026-10-10: safesearch=strict reflected in page state on /search and /images.

functional.name: goggles_id
functional.meaning: URL of a Goggle (.goggle file) that re-ranks or filters results. Verified live 2026-10-10: /goggles?q=rust with the rust_programming Goggle returned rust-lang.org pages first, unlike /search?q=rust (game and film results).

functional.name: view
functional.meaning: Local results/map view state; listed in the SvelteKit page loader's search_params (q, summary, goggles_id, view, map_src). Values not confirmed.

nonfunctional.name: source
nonfunctional.meaning: Entry-point attribution (web, relatedQueries, vcluster, llmSuggest, desktop, android, ios, newtab). Verified live 2026-10-10: ?q=bag&source=web and /goggles with source=web returned identical result lists; Brave's own clean-URL list strips it.

nonfunctional.name: origin
nonfunctional.meaning: UI origin marker (origin=search).

nonfunctional.name: summary
nonfunctional.meaning: AI summariser toggle read by the page loader; display only (inferred).

nonfunctional.name: map_src
nonfunctional.meaning: UI element that opened the map (inferred).

nonfunctional.name: action
nonfunctional.meaning: action=makeDefault conversion marker.

nonfunctional.name: ui_lang, units
nonfunctional.meaning: API-only; not honoured via the web URL (live 2026-10-10).

engines.notes: Verifier changes (2026-10-10): every functional parameter except search_lang and view was confirmed by live result comparison; search_lang is read from the URL but showed no visible effect, so it stays as plausibly functional; source confirmed non-functional live. Country, safesearch, ui_lang, useLocation and summarizer also come from cookies (SearXNG brave.py), so rendering can still vary per viewer. SearXNG says paging and tf only apply to /search and /goggles; on 2026-10-10 /videos and /news also honoured tf, and /videos paginated with offset. owner's test: search?q=bag&source=web becomes ?q=bag.

paths: /do/search, /do/dsearch (still used by browsers and Startpage's own GET example)

NOT result pages: /sp/captcha*, /sp/captcha-block (carries bc, bi, be, bds_t, bds_s plus the original parameters), /osuggestions, /suggestions, /do/settings, /do/mypage.pl (Settings URL), /sp/qi, /.within.website/

functional.name: query
functional.meaning: Search query. Verified: Startpage's own Search strings article (updated 2026-10-10) gives https://www.startpage.com/sp/search?query=%s as the browser search string.

functional.name: q
functional.meaning: Alias of query. Verified: Startpage's Firefox for Android article gives /sp/search?q=%s, and its POST versus GET article gives /do/dsearch?q=cats&cat=web&language=english.

functional.name: cat
functional.meaning: Vertical: web, images (current; Startpage's own images link is /?cat=images), pics (legacy alias still used by bangs and degoog), video, news. Verified across Startpage help, SearXNG and 4get.

functional.name: page
functional.meaning: Page number (2, 3, ...; SearXNG tested 18 pages). Confirmed in two clients; live check impossible from this network.

functional.name: page_token
functional.meaning: Opaque next-page token that Startpage issues for some verticals (4get adds it when the pagination block carries one; commit 2026-08-14 "fix video pagination"). Plausibly needed for page 2+ there.

functional.name: language
functional.meaning: Search language (english, deutsch, espanol ...): promotes results in that language and localises news. Verified: Startpage help; Startpage itself appends language=english when redirecting a bare query (observed 2026-10-10).

functional.name: lui
functional.meaning: Interface language (same naming as language). Startpage appends lui=english on redirect (observed 2026-10-10).

functional.name: with_date
functional.meaning: Time filter: d, w, m, y (h = past hour per degoog). Confirmed in SearXNG, 4get, degoog and the syear bang.

functional.name: qadf
functional.meaning: Family (safe search) filter: none, moderate, heavy. Confirmed in SearXNG (safesearch_dict) and 4get (nsfw no = heavy); Startpage help confirms a results-page filter exists.

functional.name: qsr
functional.meaning: Region filter: Startpage region codes such as en-GB_GB, de_DE, es_AR, or all. Confirmed by two independent clients (4get maps its country filter to qsr; SearXNG sends qsr=all) and by Startpage help, which documents a results-page region dropdown.

functional.name: with_region
functional.meaning: Legacy region filter (countryCH, countryNO).

functional.name: l
functional.meaning: Legacy language selector (nihongo, nederlands).

functional.name: prfe, prf
functional.meaning: Settings-URL bundle. Moved from non-functional: Startpage says the Settings URL stores all preferences, and that a new Settings URL is needed to carry a region preference, so it can change region, search language and family filter; bangs use prf= on /do/search. It also carries cosmetic preferences and is opaque.
functional.condition: keep by default; Startpage calls the preferences non-identifiable, but CheckLink may offer a strict mode that drops it

functional.name: flimgsize
functional.meaning: Image size: Small, Medium, Large, Wallpaper. Startpage help confirms the size filter; parameter name from 4get.

functional.name: image-size-select

functional.name: flimgcolor
functional.meaning: Image colour: ic:color, ic:gray, or ic:specific,isc:<red|orange|...>.

functional.name: flimgtype
functional.meaning: Image type: AnimatedGif, Clipart, Line, Photo, Transparent.

functional.name: flimglicense
functional.meaning: Image licence: p, s, sc, m, mc (public domain to free to modify commercially).

functional.name: sort_by
functional.meaning: Video sort: popular, recent (relevance is the default and is sent as no parameter).

functional.name: with_duration
functional.meaning: Video duration: short, medium, long.

nonfunctional.name: sc
nonfunctional.meaning: Anti-bot form code, regenerated per request. Verified: Startpage generates a fresh sc itself when it redirects a bare /sp/search?query=bag (observed 2026-10-10), so dropping it is safe; DandelionSprout strips it.

nonfunctional.name: segment
nonfunctional.meaning: Partner segment (startpage.udog, organic, startpage.brave, startpage.vivaldi.1).

nonfunctional.name: pl
nonfunctional.meaning: Placement/source (opensearch, ext-ff). Non-functional, with a caveat: in 2022 Startpage blocked opensearch URLs with pl removed, and DandelionSprout's rule is still disabled; degoog and 4get still send pl=opensearch. Startpage's own 2026 help documents pl-less search strings (/sp/search?query=%s and ?q=%s), so a clean URL is an official entry point.

nonfunctional.name: source
nonfunctional.meaning: Attribution.

nonfunctional.name: t
nonfunctional.meaning: Theme (device, dark); display (inferred). Startpage appends t=device on redirect.

nonfunctional.name: abp, abd, abe
nonfunctional.meaning: Ad-blocker detection flags.

nonfunctional.name: cmd, extVersion, engine0, SuggestOn
nonfunctional.meaning: Command (gen_page, process_search), extension version, backend selector, suggestions toggle. Startpage appends cmd=gen_page on redirect.

engines.notes: Verifier changes (2026-10-10): prfe/prf moved to functional (Settings URL carries region, search language and family filter); added image filters (flimgsize, image-size-select, flimgcolor, flimgtype, flimglicense), video filters (sort_by, with_duration) and page_token from 4get (scraper updated 2026-08-14); cat gains images as the current value; qsr no longer rests on one client. Live result pages could not be inspected: every request from this network (a VPN egress) was redirected to /sp/captcha-block. That redirect itself showed Startpage appending language=english, lui=english, t=device, cat=web, a fresh sc and cmd=gen_page to a bare /sp/search?query=bag, which confirms sc need not be preserved. Startpage help was read through the help-centre JSON API because the HTML pages sit behind a Cloudflare challenge. Region and family filter also live in the preferences cookie (search_results_region, disable_family_filter), so results can differ per viewer.

functional.meaning: Language boost strength 1 to 100. API-documented.

functional.name: rb, rbb
functional.meaning: Region boost country and strength. API-documented.
functional.condition: API-documented; web support not confirmed (captcha); kept because it can only change results

functional.name: lr
functional.meaning: Restrict to a language (beta). API-documented.
functional.condition: API-documented; web support not confirmed; keep

functional.name: si
functional.meaning: Maximum results per domain (0 unlimited). Verified (advanced form, API doc).

functional.name: clufmt
functional.meaning: Clustering format (1 to 5; 0 disables). API-documented.
functional.condition: API-documented; web support not confirmed; keep

functional.name: fi, fe
functional.meaning: Domains to include / exclude (comma separated, max 25). API-documented.
functional.condition: API-documented; web support not confirmed; keep

functional.name: fmt
functional.meaning: Web vertical: images, news, sst (Substack). Verified: hidden fmt=images on /images and fmt=sst on /blogs; SearXNG uses images and news. On the API the same name selects json/xml.
functional.source: https://www.mojeek.com/images (hidden fmt=images); https://www.mojeek.com/blogs (hidden fmt=sst); https://github.com/searxng/searxng/blob/f4822b3fc46726bb259d14c6332b702c76b98f82/searx/engines/mojeek.py (search_type images, news)
functional.condition: keep images, news, sst; json/xml mean an API call

functional.name: sst
functional.meaning: Sent as sst=1 by Mojeek's own Substack form together with fmt=sst. The preferences page labels sst as "Display Substack search tab" (default off), so it is most likely cosmetic; kept because it is a harmless constant that Mojeek itself always pairs with fmt=sst.
functional.source: https://www.mojeek.com/blogs (hidden sst=1); https://www.mojeek.com/preferences (sst: Display Substack option on search results page)

functional.name: foc_t
functional.meaning: Mojeek Focus topic (Cybersecurity, Dictionary, Education, Encyclopedias, Recipes, SmallWeb, TechNews, Weather ...) restricting to a curated domain set. Verified on the Focus form.

functional.name: s_foc
functional.meaning: Hidden s_foc=1 submitted with foc_t by Mojeek's Focus form; purpose not documented, plausibly the switch that applies the Focus topic.

functional.name: lang
functional.meaning: Site (interface) language en, de, fr. Verified (preferences "Site Language").

functional.name: imgpr
functional.meaning: Image provider: openverse (default) or pixabay; changes which images are shown. Verified (preferences).

nonfunctional.name: theme, hp, autocomp
nonfunctional.meaning: Theme, minimal homepage, autocomplete. Verified as display preferences; Mojeek's own cookieless example is /search?q=query&theme=dark&autocomp=0&hp=minimal.

nonfunctional.name: qsbu, qsba, qss[]
nonfunctional.meaning: Search Choice buttons/bar and listed engines.

nonfunctional.name: date, cdate, size, tlen, dlen, rp_i
nonfunctional.meaning: Show last-modified date, crawl date and document size; title and snippet length; tidy URL style. Verified: the API doc describes date, cdate and size as "Include ..." response fields and tlen/dlen as lengths.

nonfunctional.name: spell
nonfunctional.meaning: Display alternative spelling suggestions (display only).

nonfunctional.name: newtab, ref
nonfunctional.meaning: Open results in a new tab; referrer protection.

nonfunctional.name: mal, sumb, sumt, ib, tn
nonfunctional.meaning: AI summary placement, summarise button, summary tab, infoboxes, number of news items shown alongside results.

nonfunctional.name: tab
nonfunctional.meaning: Preferences page tab.

nonfunctional.name: api_key
nonfunctional.meaning: API credential; must never survive cleaning.

engines.notes: Verifier changes (2026-10-10): added s_foc (Focus form, inferred); sst kept only with fmt=sst and annotated as most likely cosmetic per the preferences label; date, cdate, size confirmed as display fields from the API doc; fmt=json/xml flagged as API calls. Cookieless mode puts preferences in the URL (Mojeek's own example /search?q=query&theme=dark&autocomp=0&hp=minimal), so shared Mojeek URLs often carry a full preference set. The SERP is behind an ALTCHA proof-of-work captcha (confirmed 2026-10-10: /search?q=bag served the captcha page), so live comparison was not done and verdicts rest on Mojeek's own forms and API doc. arc and lb are also read from cookies.
